QuestInfo.name: The Mechanic's Awakening
QuestInfo.1: Checky in the Secret Plaza said that after the Maple Alliance forms, the Empress Cygnus may be able to awaken your hidden potential. Using both mystical energies and mechanical engineering, you can reach new heights of power. All you need is Alexandrite from the mysterious mine. Take it to the Empress at the Conference Pavillion.
QuestInfo.2: Through the combined powers of the Alexandrite and Empress Cygnus, your potential has been unlocked! Behold your awesome power!
